scope: Explicitly registered static eyelid margins on a spherical globe; no automatic landmark inference or blink rig.

nih_periorbital.use: Eyelid and upper crease terminology; no numerical proportions or source images copied.

author.use: Spherical support, clearance and aperture heights are modeling approximations, not anatomical measurements.

relationships.relation: Skin and underlying components cover the anterior globe.
An upper-lid crease is associated with attachment of the eyelid elevating muscle to orbicularis tissue.
Fit registered margin samples to a spherical support with explicit clearance; do not substitute this approximation for tissue anatomy.
Gaze rotation is independent of the orbital/aperture frame.

limits: No tear lake or tear ducts
